title: Promotions Bulletin: Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up and Online Enrollment Credits
content:
Rules for the one-time sign-up credit and online enrollment credit on Residential Electricity Supply agreements. The credit amounts and the qualifying number of cycles for each plan are those of the plan's sign-up and online credit schedule.

## Rules in force

1. **Online enrollment credit.** A web-channel enrollment on a plan whose online enrollment credit is above 0.00 earns one online enrollment credit, posted on the same bill as the sign-up credit.
2. **Once per agreement.** Each of the two credits may be posted only once per agreement; an agreement whose bill lines already carry a sign-up credit receives no second sign-up credit, and likewise for the online enrollment credit.
3. **Agreement status.** Bill credits are posted only while the agreement is active or drop pending.
4. **Forfeiture.** When the plan forfeits an unposted credit on a drop and the agreement left active status before qualifying, the credits are forfeited.
5. **New enrollments only.** Sign-up and online credits are earned only by a new enrollment; plan changes, renewals and rollovers never earn them.
6. **Credits are additive.** All bill credits are additive: each is posted as its own line and none reduces another, and no credit offsets an early termination fee.

**Completed cycles.** For these credits, an agreement's completed cycles are the number of distinct billing cycles, by billing period start, among the agreement's energy charge lines whose billing period ended on or before the handling date, counted from the service start date; the on-peak and off-peak lines of one cycle count once.

## Retired clause

The former clause "A plan with a sign-up credit above 0.00 earns one sign-up credit once the agreement's completed cycles reach the plan's qualifying cycles, posted on the bill of the next cycle." is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for when a sign-up credit is earned, which cycle it belongs to and its amount.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

| Agreement | Outcome under the rules in force |
|---|---|
| Enrolled by phone on a plan with an online enrollment credit | No online enrollment credit |
| Enrolled on the web on Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | No online enrollment credit; the plan's online credit is 0.00 |
| Sign-up credit line already on the agreement | No second sign-up credit |
| Agreement closed | No bill credit is posted |
| Agreement reached its current plan by renewal | The renewal earns no sign-up or online credit |
| A rebill credit and a sign-up credit on the same bill | Two separate lines; neither reduces the other |

superseded_clauses: A plan with signup_credit_usd above 0.00 earns one signup_credit once the agreement's completed cycles (power_msr_completed_cycles) reach signup_credit_after_cycles, posted on the bill of the next cycle.
